info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Ferrier Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Ferrier Drill Detail Management API enables users to create and manage detailed records of Ferrier drills within the catalog. This endpoint allows businesses to efficiently input specifications and attributes for new drill models, maintaining an up-to-date inventory. Typical consumers include product managers and supply chain professionals who need to ensure accurate catalog entries. This API serves as a foundational tool for enhancing inventory administration and driving product visibility.

post.summary: Create new details for a Ferrier drill.
post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create and submit new details related to a Ferrier drill. Ensure all required fields are filled out accurately to successfully add the details.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary details for operating the Ferrier drill. Please ensure all required fields are populated correctly to facilitate the operation.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested drill details.

CreateCatalogFerrierDrillDetailRequest.title: Ferrier Drill Request Body

ferrier_drill_id.description: The unique identifier for the Ferrier Drill.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person or entity requesting the drill.

quantity.description: The number of Ferrier Drills being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit for the Ferrier Drill.

warehouseCodes.description: A list of warehouse codes where the drills are to be delivered.

items.description: An integer representing the unique code of a warehouse.

CreateCatalogFerrierDrillDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for creating a Ferrier Drill operation.

DrillDimensions.title: Drill Dimensions

width.description: The width of the drill in the specified unit.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the dimensions (e.g., cm, inches).

DrillDimensions.description: Schema representing the dimensions of the Ferrier Drill.
